name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a Reno-based junior explorer focused exclusively on gold properties in Nevada, one of the world's top-ranked mining jurisdictions. The company uses an Exploration Project Accelerator model that combines direct property exploration with the acquisition of royalty interests, providing diversified exposure to Nevada gold. Key assets include the Olinghouse property in Washoe County and the Palmetto project in Esmeralda County.
